title: Yang–Mills, S6 and Navier–Stokes research programmes
coverage: All 284 public files at source_commit. This pin identifies the mathematical/source snapshot; the subsequently added navigation files and this descriptor are not included in its own inventory. NS archive components have a separate exact index. The S6 archive remains externally hosted.
id_policy: ART identifiers are local handles for this versioned inventory. The commit and Git blob SHA identify the exact source. Preserve existing IDs when maintaining this inventory; mint new IDs for additional entries. IDs are not proofs, signatures, or a federation-wide registry.
purpose: Explain what was tried, why, what resulted and where the full work is located, so another human or workbench can continue a programme of any size.

programmes.title: Quantum state, tensor-band and non-Abelian vertex calculations
programmes.scope: Studies explicit quantum systems and transfer maps, including focused component snapshots. The source guide states the hypotheses; the interacting four-dimensional continuum mass-gap conclusion remains unfinished.
programmes.description_basis: Published topic guide at source_commit; no new theorem validation in the indexing pass.

programmes.title: Volume-independent actual-vacuum estimates
programmes.scope: Develops vacuum and covariance estimates in the specified systems and parameter ranges. Scope is stated in the complete source, including the later covariance-window estimates.
programmes.description_basis: Published topic guide at source_commit; no new theorem validation in the indexing pass.

programmes.title: Spatial-continuum maps and limiting obstructions
programmes.scope: Examines whether finite-regulator and oscillator calculations extend to interacting spatial limits. The current source guide identifies corrected Section 26.13 rates and a Section 27 perturbative-disk obstruction.
programmes.description_basis: Published topic guide at source_commit; no new theorem validation in the indexing pass.

programmes.title: Navier–Stokes construction: reconstruction, corrections and exact transfers
programmes.scope: Reconstructs the supplied smooth-forced positive-viscosity construction. Complete proof sources and finite checks are public; independent whole-construction analytical and Lean validation remains unfinished.
programmes.description_basis: Published topic guide at source_commit; no new theorem validation in the indexing pass.

programmes.title: S6 topology and related constructions
programmes.scope: Indexes the complete public checkpoint frozen on 6 September. Its guide links the large archive and retains the individual constructions, attempts and historical qualifications.
programmes.description_basis: Published topic guide at source_commit; no new theorem validation in the indexing pass.

programmes.title: Prescribed-path oscillator-kernel rates
programmes.scope: Source describes fixed-box oscillator conclusions and a missing volume-uniform exact-lattice bridge; formulas not newly checked.
